# origincloud_dns_hosted_zones (Data Source)

Lists a project's hosted zones, oldest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "origincloud_dns_hosted_zones" "all" {
  project = "my-project-123"
}

# A zone by its domain.
output "example" {
  value = one([for z in data.origincloud_dns_hosted_zones.all.hosted_zones : z.name if z.dns_name == "example.com"])
}

# The public zones that haven't proved control of their domain yet.
output "pending" {
  value = [for z in data.origincloud_dns_hosted_zones.all.hosted_zones : z.dns_name if z.state == "PENDING_VERIFICATION"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose hosted zones to list.

### Read-Only

- `hosted_zones` (Attributes List) The hosted zones listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted_zones))

<a id="nestedatt--hosted_zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted_zones`

Read-Only:

- `challenge` (Attributes) How a public zone proves control of its name, and how it went. Unset for a private zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted_zones--challenge))
- `create_time` (String) When the zone was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the zone, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`.
- `dns_name` (String) The domain, such as `example.com`, without the final dot; answered in lowercase. A public zone's has at least two labels and at most 235 characters, so its challenge name fits. A private zone's may have one label, but isn't `internal` or a name below it, which answer each instance's own name. Neither is one of the platform's own domains or a name below one.
- `name` (String) The zone's resource name.
- `name_servers` (List of String) The name servers to delegate a public zone to at its registrar, as NS records of its name. Fixed when the zone is created. Empty for a private zone.
- `state` (String) Whether the zone is answered. One of `PENDING_VERIFICATION`, `ACTIVE`, `SUSPENDED`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.
- `urn` (String) The zone's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
- `visibility` (String) Where the zone is answered. One of `PUBLIC`, `PRIVATE`.

<a id="nestedatt--hosted_zones--challenge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted_zones.challenge`

Read-Only:

- `dns_name` (String) The name of the TXT record to create where the zone's name is hosted now: `_origin-challenge.` followed by the zone's `dns_name`.
- `expire_time` (String) When a pending zone that hasn't verified is deleted; unset once it verified. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `last_check` (String) What the check `VerifyHostedZone` made found. Set only in that method's response. One of `OK`, `NOT_FOUND`, `NAME_HELD`.
- `suspend_time` (String) When the zone was suspended; unset unless it is `SUSPENDED`. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `suspension_reason` (String) Why the zone was suspended; unset unless it is `SUSPENDED`. One of `CHALLENGE_LOST`.
- `token` (String) The value the TXT record holds.
- `verify_time` (String) When the zone verified; unset while it is pending. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
